  sequences are aligned.

Replace the container placeholder with a pinned BioContainer found through one
bounded live BioContainers lookup. Use a bare tagged reference without
`docker://` or a digest.

```yaml
class: GalaxyUserTool
id: analysis-v1

version: 0.1.0

shell_command: |
  set -eu
  selected-command \
    --input "$(inputs.input.path)" \
    --output result.tsv

inputs:
  - name: input
    type: data
    format: [tabular]

outputs:

    type: data
    format: tabular

```

import base64, textwrap
script = r'''
import csv
import os
import pathlib
import re
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys
import zipfile

archive_path = sys.argv[1]
per_path = sys.argv[2]
summary_path = sys.argv[3]

print(subprocess.run([\"phykit\", \"--version\"], text=True, capture_output=True).stdout.strip())

numeric_re = re.compile(r\"[-+]?(?:\\d+\\.\\d*|\\.\\d+|\\d+)(?:[eE][-+]?\\d+)?\")
rows = []
with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_path) as zf:
    names = sorted(n for n in zf.namelist() if n.endswith(\".mafft\") and not n.endswith(\"/\"))
    if not names:
        raise SystemExit(\"No .mafft alignments found in archive\")
    for name in names:
        data = zf.read(name)
        pathlib.Path(\"alignment.fa\").write_bytes(data)
        proc = subprocess.run([\"phykit\", \"pis\", \"alignment.fa\"], text=True, capture_output=True)
        if proc.returncode "'!= 0:
            raise RuntimeError(f"phykit pis failed for {name}: {proc.stderr}'"\\n{proc.stdout}\")
        text = (proc.stdout + \"\\n\" + proc.stderr).strip()
        nums = numeric_re.findall(text)
        if len(nums) < 3:
            raise RuntimeError(f\"Could not parse phykit pis output for {name}: {text"'!r}")
        pi_sites = int(float(nums[-3]))
        total_sites = int(float(nums[-2]))
        percent = float(nums[-1])
        rows.append((name, pi_sites, total_sites, percent))

percents = [r[3] for r in rows]
median_percent = statistics.median(percents)

with open(per_path, "w", newline="") as fh:
    writer = csv.writer(fh, delimiter="'"\\t\")
    writer.writerow([\"alignment\", \"parsimony_informative_sites\", \"total_sites\", \"percent_parsimony_informative\"])
    writer.writerows(rows)

with open(summary_path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:
    writer = csv.writer(fh, delimiter=\"\\t\")
    writer.writerow([\"alignment_count\", \"median_percent_parsimony_informative\"])
    writer.writerow([len(rows), format(median_percent, \".15g\")])
'''.lstrip()
print(base64.b64encode(script.encode()).decode())
PY"
